title: Big Buck Bunny
description: A big rabbit takes revenge on three bullying rodents in this Blender Foundation open movie. Entirely made with free and open-source software.

title: Sintel
description: A lonely young woman, Sintel, helps and befriends a dragon she names Scales. Lost and injured, she journeys across a hostile world to find him again. Blender Foundation open movie.

title: Cosmos Laundromat — First Cycle
description: A depressed sheep named Frank wishes for a second chance and meets a strange salesman who offers him exactly that. Blender Foundation open movie (first cycle).

title: Tears of Steel
description: In a future Amsterdam, a group of warriors and scientists recreate the past to save the world from robots. Blender Foundation open movie, live action combined with CGI.
